candidate_structure.information_flow: The first call sees all common inputs and exclusively commits an admissibility covenant before any candidate artifact exists. The final call consumes that covenant and also sees all common inputs, including the anchor policy, preserving direct executable lineage visibility while denying the final call authority to revise evidence admissibility.
candidate_structure.name: Preconstruction Admissibility Covenant with Exclusive Downstream Materialization

calls.objective: Identify the inherited assumptions being rejected and commit one binding covenant of admissible evidence, public obligations, and unresolved tensions before any candidate artifact exists. Hold no policy-construction authority and prescribe no implementation behavior.

Consume the immediately preceding covenant as binding, retain direct visibility of the anchor and public obligations, and emit exactly one complete contract-compliant policy without revising evidence admissibility or reinstating the forbidden inherited mechanism.

mode_certificate.forbidden_inherited_mechanism: terminal self-compression of an anchor-derived reversible-delta repair stack
mode_certificate.independent_replacement_principle: Use non-overlapping authorities: bind admissible public evidence before construction, then grant only the downstream call artifact-construction authority while preserving direct anchor visibility.
rejected_assumptions: The anchor must remain the mutable ancestor of every admissible candidate.
Evidence may remain provisional until the same authority retrospectively validates its own construction path.
One terminal actor should control both evidence admissibility and policy construction.

qualitative_hypothesis.causal_change: Introduce a static separation-of-powers edge: an upstream authority binds admissible evidence and obligations before construction, while a downstream authority retains direct anchor visibility but exclusively materializes the policy without revising that commitment.
qualitative_hypothesis.expected_effect: The authority separation should reduce circular self-validation and anchor-path dependence while changing both evidence-commitment behavior and artifact state-transition behavior.
qualitative_hypothesis.falsifier: all-valid matched majority and strict-median contract, with no score
qualitative_hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: The champion gives one terminal authority control over evidence admission, anchor-derived construction, and retrospective self-validation, structurally favoring local repair and late justification.

structural_mutation.after: A preconstruction call exclusively commits evidence admissibility, then a final call consumes that commitment, retains direct common-input visibility, and exclusively emits one policy.
structural_mutation.before: One terminal producer owns evidence admission, anchor-derived reversible state transitions, and terminal causal compression.
structural_mutation.factor: static separation-of-powers edge between evidence admissibility and policy construction
structural_mutation.why_structural: The single authority-bearing edge redistributes control and fixes evidence timing across two calls while replacing provisional reversible repair with covenant-bound forward materialization. It carries no whole policy artifact, hides no anchor evidence, and is not terminal-role fission.

receipt.role: score-blind R9 counter_hypothesis structure architect; never policy code
